description: Format and minify SQL. Operations: "beautify" — Beautify SQL with newlines before clauses.; "minify" — Minify SQL to a single line.. Call with "operation" plus "input" (and "options" where relevant).

input.description: beautify: The SQL to beautify. minify: The SQL to minify.

operation.description: beautify — Beautify SQL with newlines before clauses. minify — Minify SQL to a single line.

options.description: Options for the chosen operation (each says which operations use it).

indentSize.description: Indent width in spaces. Used by: beautify.

lineBreaksBeforeClauses.description: Start each clause (FROM, WHERE, …) on a new line. Used by: beautify.

uppercaseKeywords.description: Uppercase SQL keywords. Used by: beautify, minify.

name: sql
title: SQL Formatter
